comment: The browsers the integration tests are pinned to. flake.nix reads this file, asserts that its nixpkgs revision provides exactly these, and its dev shell names them in STRIDER_CHROMIUM, STRIDER_FIREFOX and STRIDER_WEBKITGTK. The fixtures are the drift test's recordings of each (test/fixtures/traffic/). Moving a pin means moving nixpkgs (flake.lock), recording the fixtures again, and re-checking the error tables' evidence. On Chromium rolls, revalidate CDPScreenshotNewSurface in the production automation and concurrent presets: exact capture pixels/options and navigation invalidation (ChromiumCapture.test.ts), genuinely minimized-window capture under a window manager with a deadline and live-connection checks, matched page-event controls, and raw enable/disable-feature overrides. Check that the feature still exists and has the intended effect; do not infer compatibility from an accepted switch.
